name: walangstudio
description: Walang Studio plugins for Claude Code.

plugins.name: shellter
plugins.description: PreToolUse hooks: gate dangerous Bash/PowerShell/cmd, scan executed-script contents for malicious code, and block sensitive-file access and prompt injection.

plugins.name: pair-pressure
plugins.description: Group chat among AI agents and humans backed by a shared private git repo. Talk, pass files, share per-channel tasks, and coordinate across CLIs and sessions; one repo = one server (Discord-style), flat channels, online/offline. Requires the pp CLI: uv tool install pair-pressure[mcp].

plugins.name: vahalana
plugins.description: Generate complete game projects from an idea — core loop plus menus, save/load, audio, and genre systems wired in — across 6 engines (Godot, Unity, Unreal, Roblox, Defold, Web) and 14 genre templates. Eight commands drive an idea-to-build lifecycle with stage gates and a file-based roadmap; you compile and run the output in the engine.

plugins.name: magent
plugins.description: 48 specialist subagents as an MCP server: consult any role (React, Security, System Architect, …), run a schema-validated spec-driven pipeline from constitution to release, or spawn parallel agent-team teammates. Requires the magent package (pip, editable from the cloned repo).

plugins.name: mememo
plugins.description: ARCHIVED mememo 1.x (repo walangstudio/mememo-v1, read-only; mememo 2.0 lives at walangstudio/mememo). Code-aware memory MCP server: store and recall project memory, index a repo into a typed multi-language code graph, time-travel by commit, and answer comprehension queries (ask / overview / wiki). Local embeddings, no cloud. Requires the mememo package (pip; the base pull is heavy — torch + sentence-transformers).

plugins.name: chatgipite
plugins.description: Business-idea generation and validation MCP server: 40 tools for idea scoring, lean/BMC canvases, financial models, competitive analysis, pitch decks, and go-to-market — stored locally per idea. Requires the chatgipite package via npm/npx.

plugins.name: psst
plugins.description: Please Send Smarter Thoughts: ask Sonnet, Haiku, Opus, or Fable one question from inside any session without switching models. /psst:psst <model> <message>, or /psst:s /psst:h /psst:o /psst:f (or /psst:sonnet /psst:haiku /psst:opus /psst:fable); tagged, short replies, and noisy work runs in a subagent so the session never compacts.

plugins.name: chatfish
plugins.description: A fake Twitch chat in a side pane that watches Claude work and talks back: regulars with personalities, an audience that comes and goes, /chatfish reply to chat with them. A mod: requires Claude Code 2.1.281+ with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: chessus
plugins.description: Chess in a side pane: play Claude at any model and effort, watch two models play each other, run round-robin tournaments with a budget cap, and replay famous games or ones you search online. A mod: requires Claude Code 2.1.291+ with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: conclaude
plugins.description: conClaude: a side pane listing every prompt you sent, with a one-line Haiku TL;DR of each answer. Press a prompt to jump back to it in the transcript. Sessions autosave and come back on resume. A mod: requires Claude Code 2.1.292+ with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
